output.reason: The linked PR [ev-ee7a4ed528ad] says the CRD-to-MRD conversion is behind a beta feature flag that defaulted to false. So exposure is not just "a package declares SafeStart", which is what the proposed undecidable leaf describes. Exposure also depends on that flag being enabled. The flag's name, and whether it is still off by default in 2.0.0, are not shown: the excerpt is truncated, and the changed-files list [ev-6f0a3f0f7449] only shows that values.yaml, deployment.yaml and core.go were modified. The release note [ev-2c984df9c0e9] gives neither the flag nor any condition. To write a correct feature-gate or values-key condition, we need the flag name and its default in the 2.0.0 release, for example from values.yaml or the core.go flag definition.
